title: prove the claude cli behaviors via the BrainCli interface
description:
## .what

prove the real claude cli behaviors rhachet relies on, in rhachet-brains-anthropic, via the `BrainCli` interface rhachet formalizes.

## .why

these behaviors are claude's, so the anthropic supplier is where they are proven. rhachet then stops to spend api credit on them, and stops to retest a real claude on every unrelated rhachet change.

## .depends on

the `BrainCli` interface task in `ehmpathy/rhachet` (formalize the BrainCli interface). start once it lands.

## .the behaviors to prove (each pinned today by a rhachet realbrain suite)

| behavior | rhachet suite today |
|---|---|
| a real tui submits a dispatched say across turns; its transcript reads back | `clone.joker.realbrain`, `clone.realbrain` |
| a bulk paste commits only with a length-scaled submit delay | `clone.saybulk-probe.realbrain` |
| a real claude writes the user turn at submit, even while queued | `clone.transcript-lag.realbrain` |
| a real render does not trip the modal classifier; a multi-line paste lands as one turn | `clone.modalprobe.realbrain`, `clone.screen-dogfood.realbrain` |
| a real claude loads the memory files laid down (CLAUDE.md to boot.md, `--setting-sources user`, `claudeMdExcludes`) | `brain-dir-boot.journey` |
| a real claude-code clears a dead login as expected | `enroll.shared-brain-auth` |

run them on haiku, one shared session where the seam allows.

## .after

once proven here, rhachet's copies of these suites move to a mock cli (tracked in rhachet, the fence followup).

## .source

review of ehmpathy/rhachet#691, 2026-11-04
